Class DateUtilsTest

@IsTest
private class DateUtilsTest

Test class for DateUtils. Verifies timezone conversion methods (GMT, local, custom timezones), Unix time conversion, day of week calculations, and null handling across all utility methods.

Methods

@IsTest
private static void convertNullValuesTest()

Verifies that all timezone conversion methods properly handle null datetime values. Tests convertToGmtTimeZone(), convertToLocalTimeZone(), and convertToTimeZone() all return null when given null input.

@IsTest
private static void convertToGmtTimeZoneTest()

Verifies conversion from user's local timezone (America/Los_Angeles) to GMT. Tests that the converted datetime is later than the source datetime due to timezone offset.

@IsTest
private static void convertToLocalTimeZoneTest()

Verifies conversion from GMT to user's local timezone (America/Los_Angeles). Tests that the converted datetime is earlier than the source datetime due to timezone offset.

@IsTest
private static void convertToTimeZoneTest()

Verifies conversion from GMT to a custom timezone (America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires). Tests that the converted datetime is earlier than the source datetime due to timezone offset.

@IsTest
private static void getDatetimeTest()

Verifies that getDatetime() correctly parses datetime strings based on provided format patterns. Tests both full year ('yyyy') and two-digit year ('yy') formats.

Since:
    11/08/2025

@IsTest
private static void getUnixTimeTest()

Verifies that getUnixTime() correctly converts a Datetime to Unix timestamp. Tests conversion of a known datetime to Unix time (seconds since January 1, 1970), verifies epoch time returns 0, and validates null handling.

Since:
    11/08/2025

@TestSetup
private static void setup()

Creates test user with Los Angeles timezone for timezone conversion tests

@IsTest
private static void weekDayTest()

Verifies that weekDay() correctly returns the day of week for a given date. Tests that September 18, 2024 (Wednesday) returns 4 (1=Sunday through 7=Saturday).

Since:
